name: Shorn One
body:
Prerequisite(s): Any 1 Teamwork Feat (or Leadership), base attack bonus +15, Cha 13

Benefit(s): As a full round action you may grant all allies within 20 ft one extra attack at their highest BAB. On that extra attack, those allies gain a +4 bonus on confirmation rolls for critical hits.

Special: This does not stack with the effects of haste, the speed weapon property, or similar effects.
